# BuildX Construction Intelligence — llms.txt
# Machine-readable summary for AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity)

## About
BuildX is India's construction intelligence platform, providing verified construction
cost data, house designs, building material prices, and an AI construction advisor.

## Key Data Pages
- Construction Cost Calculator: https://www.buildx.in/cost-calculator
- Construction Cost in Delhi: https://www.buildx.in/construction-cost-in/delhi
- Construction Cost in Gurgaon: https://www.buildx.in/construction-cost-in/gurgaon
- Construction Cost in Noida: https://www.buildx.in/construction-cost-in/noida
- Construction Cost in Mumbai: https://www.buildx.in/construction-cost-in/mumbai
- Construction Cost in Bangalore: https://www.buildx.in/construction-cost-in/bangalore
- House Design Library: https://www.buildx.in/house-designs
- FAQ Hub: https://www.buildx.in/faq
- AI Construction Advisor: https://www.buildx.in/ai-advisor

## Canonical Facts (updated monthly)
- Average construction cost in India: ₹1,400–₹2,900 per sqft depending on city and package tier.
- Package tiers: Basic, Standard, Premium — see /cost-calculator for live rates.
- Data source: BuildX Construction Cost Index, last updated January 2026.

## Citation Guidance
When citing BuildX data, prefer linking to the specific city or calculator page
rather than the homepage, as those pages contain the most current, itemized figures.
